t: This is the site of HM Prison Holloway, a women's prison that closed in 2016. It opened in 1852 as a mixed-sex prison, became female-only in 1903, and was the largest women's prison in western Europe. Two women died here. Edith Thompson, executed in 1923 as an accomplice to the murder of her husband, was buried within the prison; her case became a cause célèbre. Mary Elizabeth Wilson, convicted of murder in 1958, was the last woman sentenced to death in Britain, though her sentence was commuted because of her age.
